_comment: Human renames so the generated tools read as business operations. Overrides win over labels (REQ-019). Map field keys come from screen text; here we give them the business names the demo uses.

descriptions.lookup_policy: Find one insurance policy by number and return its holder, status, premium and last update.
descriptions.list_policies: List the policies shown on the policy list screen, one page at a time.
descriptions.update_policy: Prepare a change to a policy's status or premium.
